summary: Integration verify PASS. Smoke: 28/28, 0 regressions (13 baseline + 15 new: 3 edge, 7 concurrency, 5 agent). Restarted LIVE daemon by exact PID (50536->53691; never pkill); workspace auto-restored from BASE/workspace; new routes confirmed live.
